extension.added_target_reason: single previously eligible small CMakeFiles tree compacted to restore a narrow launch margin after shared free space dipped below threshold
extension.script_hash_scope_note: Added target 084 was prepared and removed by the currently hashed compact_one.py. The earlier v1 receipt set preserves commands/results but does not claim this file hash was frozen contemporaneously for every earlier target.

free_space_observations.caveat: Concurrent task-owned clone compaction and temporary restoration altered shared df; do not attribute global delta solely to these CMakeFiles. Per-target removal receipts preserve their own df readings.

receipt_errata.issue: Contains post-removal df value due first script revision. Use prepare.df_before and remove.measured_free_increase_since_prepare; preserve original receipt.

restoration_limits.ACL: Every target had zero ACL entries; normalized listing was verified after restore.
restoration_limits.birthtime: Recorded but filesystem-created birthtime changes during extraction.
restoration_limits.hardlinks: Every archived regular file had nlink=1; archive restoration does not reconstruct shared inode relationships.

scope.mutated_path_rule: Only inventoried regular files were unlinked; only inventoried empty directories below CMakeFiles were rmdir-ed; a restore pointer remains in each compacted root.
